gh search repos "tours activities dataset" --sort stars
gh search repos "tour operator dataset" --sort stars
WebSearch site:github.com dataset tours activities reviews viator/getyourguide/klook (blocked, session web-search budget exhausted)

candidates.name: getyourguide/partner-api-spec
candidates.what_it_holds: Official OpenAPI 3.0 specification for GetYourGuide's Partner API (booking, availability, pricing, activity catalogue endpoints), maintained by GetYourGuide itself. Apache-2.0, updated 11 Sep 2026 (actively maintained). No data committed -- it's a machine-readable contract for a partner-gated API, so pulling real activity/booking volume data requires a partner account/API key (not a public open pull).
candidates.why_useful: If the team ever wanted a legitimate, ToS-compliant path to GetYourGuide activity/pricing/availability data as an Airbnb-Experiences-adjacent demand proxy (gap 9/20, adjacent supply), this is the correct machine-readable starting point rather than scraping. Low usefulness without a partner key, but it is real and current.
candidates.time_coverage: current API surface only, not historical

candidates.name: triscero/selenium_airbnb_scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Selenium-based scraper targeting the Airbnb Experiences pages to extract the geographic location of listed experiences. No data files committed (code only), small repo, last updated 20 Jun 2026, no license declared.
candidates.why_useful: Directly targets Airbnb Experiences (not just home-listings) -- the only repo found in this sweep that touches Experiences data acquisition specifically. Confirms no public dataset exists yet for Experiences volume/geography, only ad hoc scraping code. Per project rules this scrapes airbnb.com directly and must NOT be run -- catalogued as method only, human ToS call required.
candidates.geography: unspecified (whatever Experiences markets the scraper is pointed at)
candidates.time_coverage: n/a (live scrape only, no stored data)

candidates.name: piotrv1001/how-to-scrape-viator-in-nodejs
candidates.what_it_holds: Node.js example wrapping the Apify "Viator Scraper" actor to pull Viator tour listing data (title, price, rating, location) via Apify's hosted infrastructure. No data committed; requires an Apify account/actor run to get output. 1 star, updated 16 Mar 2026.
candidates.why_useful: A working, current method to acquire Viator (TripAdvisor-owned tours/activities OTA) listing-level data as a competitor/adjacent-supply proxy for Experiences-style demand (gap 9). Not Airbnb-specific and requires a paid/rate-limited third-party service (Apify) to actually run, so usefulness is marginal without further investment.
candidates.geography: global (whatever cities the actor is queried for)

candidates.name: Huntehhh/viator-scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Small, undocumented Viator scraper repo, 0 stars, no description, last updated 25 May 2025. No data files visible from the repo listing/description alone.
candidates.why_useful: Another candidate method for Viator tour/activity data if the sanctioned-sources list is ever expanded, but unmaintained and unverified -- flagged for completeness only, not recommended for follow-up over the Apify-actor version above.

candidates.name: roberttomjoseph/viator-scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Another small, undocumented Viator scraper, 0 stars, dated 31 Dec 2022 (stale, ~4 years old). No description, no visible committed data.
candidates.why_useful: Marginal duplicate of the Apify-actor approach; included only for completeness since it is the oldest of the three Viator scrapers found and could conceivably use a different (non-Apify) extraction method worth a quick look if the team pursues this thread.

notes: This theme is essentially a dead end on GitHub as of Sep 2026: no committed datasets, release assets, Zenodo/Kaggle pointers, or academic replication packages exist for Airbnb Experiences, Viator, GetYourGuide, or Klook. Searches for 'airbnb experiences dataset', 'tours activities dataset', and 'tour operator dataset' returned zero results; 'getyourguide' and 'klook' bare-keyword searches returned dozens of hits but every single one is a UI/app clone (React/Vue portfolio projects), a coupon/cashback content-farm repo, an internal company repo, or a config/profile repo -- none hold or acquire real tour/activity/experiences data. 'viator scraper' surfaced exactly three tiny, unmaintained-to-lightly-maintained scraper repos (one wrapping a paid Apify actor) and nothing else. The one genuinely useful find is GetYourGuide's own official Partner API OpenAPI spec (getyourguide/partner-api-spec), which is a legitimate, current, Apache-2.0-licensed method -- but it requires partner credentials to pull any actual data, so it does not give a free/public route to activity volumes or pricing. I did not find anything on 'hotel-on-Airbnb' listing data (Airbnb's expansion into hotel/boutique listings) either -- that sub-topic returned nothing distinguishable from ordinary Airbnb-clone tutorial repos in the searches run. Two of six allotted gh search calls and both attempted WebSearch calls were blocked/exhausted (session-wide WebSearch budget of 200 had already been used up by other scouts before I could run mine), so I could not cross-check with a browser-side search; a scout with WebSearch budget remaining should retry 'site:github.com getyourguide OR viator OR klook dataset -clone -tutorial' and also try Zenodo/Kaggle-specific phrasing ('tour and activity booking dataset kaggle') since GitHub itself appears to hold nothing substantive for this theme. Recommend deprioritizing further GitHub-specific search on this exact theme and, if the team wants Experiences/tours data at all, going directly to TripAdvisor/Viator's own investor disclosures or academic tourism-recommendation papers (which sometimes release scraped GetYourGuide/Viator listings as supplementary data) rather than general repo search.
